components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank"
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank"
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized by
            removing every non-digit character and must contain exactly 10 digits
            after stripping; the normalized 10-digit value is stored and returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:
      title: Owner page
      description: A page of pet owners.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:
          title: Content
          description: Pet owners in the requested page.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        page:
          title: Page
          description: Zero-based page index.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 0
        size:
          title: Size
          description: Requested page size.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 1
          example: 5
        totalElements:
          title: Total elements
          description: Total number of owners matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int64
          minimum: 0
          example: 10
        totalPages:
          title: Total pages
          description: Total number of pages matching the request.
          type: integer

The normalization is now correctly scoped to `telephone` only. The refactor is complete and the full suite is green (`Tests run: 2, Failures: 0, Errors: 0`).

## What I changed in response to the review

I agreed with all three findings — they match idioms the codebase already establishes — and restructured accordingly:

1. **Validation moved to `rest/validation`** (finding #1): added `TelephoneValidation` (annotation) + `TelephoneValidator` (`ConstraintValidator<…, String>`), paralleling `PetAgeValidation`/`PetAgeValidator`. The validator strips non-digits from the raw DTO value and checks for exactly 10 digits. It's wired declaratively onto the DTO field via `x-field-extra-annotation` in `openapi.yml` — the same mechanism `PetAgeValidation` uses on `birthDate`.

2. **400 now flows through the standard error path** (finding #2): because the rule is a Bean Validation constraint, a failure raises `MethodArgumentNotValidException` and is rendered by `ExceptionControllerAdvice.handleMethodArgumentNotValidException` as a structured `ProblemDetail` with `schemaValidationErrors`, field, and rejected value — consistent with every other field. The hand-rolled empty-bodied 400 in the controller is gone; `addOwner` is back to its original form.

3. **Normalization lives in the mapper** (finding #3): `OwnerMapper.toOwner(OwnerFieldsDto)` now maps `telephone` through a `normalizeTelephone` step that strips non-digits, so the stored/returned value is the 10-digit form. Validation (count only) and transformation (mutation) are cleanly separated.

### One correction to note
The reviewer's suggested "normalization in the mapper" needed care: my first attempt used a plain `default String` helper, which MapStruct auto-selected as an implicit `String→String` conversion and applied to `firstName`/`lastName`/`address`/`city` as well (caught by a test failing with 500). I fixed it with `@Named("normalizeTelephone")` + `qualifiedByName`, which excludes the method from automatic selection so it only runs where explicitly referenced. Verified in the generated `OwnerMapperImpl` — `normalizeTelephone` is applied to `telephone` and nothing else.

On the minor note about `updateOwner`: I left it unchanged since the spec scopes this to create, but the rule is now a reusable annotation, so applying it there later (if wanted) is a one-line addition to the DTO/field.
